subject: MedBridge discovery: POC scope for streaming + func-calls + rerank
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@hemlock.ai>, Samantha Park <samantha@medbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: MedBridge discovery: POC scope for streaming + func-calls + rerank

Hi Alex / Samantha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared alignment. If I missed anything, flag and I’ll update.

Summary of pain points you called out:
- Periodic latency spikes during bulk document ingestion and search; 95/99p particularly sensitive for triage workflows.
- High per-token cost for nightly indexing and rerank passes — need a plan to control unit economics.
- Need streaming partial results for the clinician triage UI (lower time-to-first-byte).
- Structured output / function-calling to reliably extract medication/order entities into your EHR shim.
- Desire for a hybrid model: hosted for dev and a private/VPC option for production (HIPAA).

POC goals (proposed):
1) Validate streaming + function-calling in a sample triage flow (live partial results + structured JSON output that maps to your order schema).
2) Evaluate embedding + rerank flow on a 5k-document sample to measure recall and cost-per-query with our caching/batching enabled.
3) Measure latency percentiles under a 15 req/s sustained load and a 60 req/s short burst profile.

Technical ask from your side:
- Sample payloads (api-sample.json is fine) and typical document sizes.
- A technical contact who can join an engineer call to walk through infra constraints (networking, VPC, KMS).

Proposed timeline / resources:
- Week 0: NDA + SOC2 artifacts exchange (we can share SOC2 summary).
- Week 1: Technical deep-dive + test data handoff.
- Week 2–3: POC run (streaming + func-calls smoke; rerank on 5k), with daily short syncs.
- Week 4: Results, recommendations (quantization, batching, rollout plan).

Attaching a one-page PoC-scope and an example API payload.

Next steps (I’ll own):
- Send NDA/ SOC2 links (see DocuSign link below).
- Schedule 60-min engineer-to-engineer call (Jordan, can you suggest 2 slots?).

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly on this.

— Priyom

Thanks Priyom — useful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

Constraints / context:
- SLA target we care about: 99p under 250ms for the triage UI (we can tolerate higher 99p for heavy batch jobs).
- Sustained throughput: ~15 qps for live triage, up to 60 qps sporadic bursts during shift change.
- Document size: average ~1.2k tokens; indexing jobs can batch up to 200 documents at a time.
- Compliance: HIPAA required; on-prem or VPC preferred in prod.

Evaluation metrics we’ll use for the POC:
- 99p latency, median latency, time-to-first-byte (TTFB) for streaming partials.
- Cost-per-query computed with your batching/caching knobs enabled.
- Rerank precision@10 and recall lift vs. current vector store baseline.

I’m attaching a sample payload (api-sample.json) and a short doc with indexing profile. Samantha will be our primary contact for scheduling.

We’re good to proceed with the proposed plan. We’ll need an NDA before sharing full data.

— Alex

Subject: Re: MedBridge discovery: POC scope for streaming + func-calls + rerank

Appreciate the details Alex — a couple of product notes and risks so we have clarity before the tech deep-dive: 

Technical notes / risk register:
- Streaming: we’ll implement chunked streaming for TTB; need to verify content-length behavior for 1.2k token docs and how long-lived connections behave through your LB.
- Function-calls / structured outputs: we typically map LLM output through a strict JSON schema validation and fallback to a deterministic extractor if schema fails. Need sample order schema from you.
- Rerank: we recommend using approx 128-dim dense embeddings for the first pass and a lightweight cross-encoder on top for final rerank; cross-encoder cost is heavier but limited to top-50 candidates.
- Caching / batching: to hit cost targets we’ll enable prefix caching and adaptive batching — please confirm whether your indexing pipeline can accept batched acknowledgment semantics.

Action items for us (Jordan / me):
- Jordan: draft the minimal SDK change list (streaming + func-call friendly serializers, a schema helper) and estimated engineering hours.
- I’ll draft the POC test plan and success criteria (latency thresholds, rerank lift).

Jordan — can you take lead on the SDK bullet and share a short RFC before the deep-dive? I can share the POC test-plan doc to Alex and Samantha once we have it.

— Marissa

Subject: Re: MedBridge discovery: POC scope for streaming + func-calls + rerank

Following up with the SDK notes I promised — high-level plan. I’ll share a short RFC by EOD Friday.

Proposed SDK work (minimal viable for POC):
1) Streaming client: add a streaming iterator that yields partial tokens and exposes a time-to-first-chunk metric. (Estimate: 2 dev days + 1 test day)
2) Function-call helpers: schema decorator + strict serializer that enforces output types and returns validation errors for fallback flows. (Estimate: 3 dev days)
3) Rerank helper: a small wrapper to run candidate cross-encoder on top of embeddings and an example batching pipeline showing top-K pruning. (Estimate: 2 dev days)

Risks / questions:
- Tokenization mismatch between your text pipeline and our tokenizer can cause schema validation edge cases; if you can run our small tokenization tool on a handful of documents that’ll speed validation.
- If you require on-prem inference for production, we’ll need to validate GPU availability and KMS arrangements early.

I’ll propose two 60-min slots for the tech deep-dive: Friday 8/6 09:00–10:00 PT or Monday 8/9 11:00–12:00 PT. Priyom, pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite.

— Jordan

Hi all — thank you, this looks good and aligns with our expectations. Two quick clarifications before the deep-dive: 

1) Schema: I’ll share the order/medication JSON schema this afternoon (SLA fields + required enums). Will the SDK serializer accept nullable fields and return a structured error we can log?
2) Rerank weighting: our product team prefers a relevance-first weighting but wants recency to be a tie-breaker (50/30/20 relevance/clinical-score/recency). Is that straightforward to encode in the rerank helper or should we handle a custom scorer in our app layer?

Slots: 8/6 09:00 PT works for our engineer (Alex) — please send an invite.

I’ll also complete the NDA signature request once I receive the DocuSign link.

Best,
